cases.name: CHK-001 happy: DEV phase info exposes ordinal and allowed transitions
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.split("\\").join("/") + "/packages/main/dist/core/phase-flow.js"); const info = m.getPhaseInfo("DEV"); return { ordinal: info.ordinal, total: info.total, label: info.label, next: info.allowedNext.includes("TEST_CASE"), rollback: info.allowedRollback.includes("PLAN") };

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: terminal and unknown phases are handled
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.split("\\").join("/") + "/packages/main/dist/core/phase-flow.js"); const discarded = m.getPhaseInfo("DISCARDED"); const unknown = m.getPhaseInfo("NOPE"); const health = m.checkPhaseTransition("DEV", "NOPE"); return { discardedTerminal: discarded.terminal, discardedOrdinal: discarded.ordinal, unknownNull: unknown === null, unknownWarning: health.kind === "unknown" && !!health.warning };

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: legal rollback is not confused with illegal jump
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.split("\\").join("/") + "/packages/main/dist/core/phase-flow.js"); return { testRollback: m.checkPhaseTransition("TEST", "DEV"), reviewRollback: m.checkPhaseTransition("TEST_CASE_REVIEW", "DEV"), illegalJump: m.checkPhaseTransition("DEV", "TEST") };

cases.name: CHK-002 happy: status shows phase ordinal and allowed transitions
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import("node:child_process"); const out = execFileSync(process.execPath, ["packages/main/dist/cli.js", "status", "--concise"], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); return { hasOrdinal: out.includes("**Phase**: 6/9 TEST_CASE"), hasNext: out.includes("allowed next: TEST_CASE_REVIEW"), hasRollback: out.includes("allowed rollback: DEV") };

cases.name: CHK-002 edge: transition health renderer reports drift without mutating story
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.split("\\").join("/") + "/packages/main/dist/core/phase-flow.js"); const health = m.checkPhaseTransition("PLAN", "TEST"); return { ok: health.ok, kind: health.kind, warning: !!health.warning, main: m.formatPhaseOrdinal("PLAN"), worktree: m.formatPhaseOrdinal("TEST") };

cases.name: CHK-002 adversarial: status phase health remains read-only
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import("node:child_process"); const tracked = ["--", ".koala", "docs/story/actives/B-fc3b/index.json"]; const before = execFileSync("git", ["status", "--short", ...tracked], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); execFileSync(process.execPath, ["packages/main/dist/cli.js", "status", "--concise"], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); const after = execFileSync("git", ["status", "--short", ...tracked], { cwd: $root, encoding: "utf8" }); return before === after;

cases.name: CHK-003 happy: fixture covers phase-flow and status output
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const text = fs.readFileSync($root + "/packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-ordinal-status-health.json", "utf8"); return { hasPhaseFlowCase: text.includes("DEV phase info exposes ordinal"), hasStatusCase: text.includes("status shows phase ordinal"), hasRefs: text.includes("B-fc3b:CHK-001:happy:0") && text.includes("B-fc3b:CHK-002:happy:0") };

cases.name: CHK-003 edge: fixture covers rollback and unknown phase warnings
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const text = fs.readFileSync($root + "/packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-ordinal-status-health.json", "utf8"); return { rollback: text.includes("legal rollback is not confused"), unknown: text.includes("unknown phases are handled"), drift: text.includes("reports drift") };

cases.name: CHK-003 adversarial: fixture covers illegal jump and status read-only
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const text = fs.readFileSync($root + "/packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-ordinal-status-health.json", "utf8"); return { illegal: text.includes("illegalJump"), readonly: text.includes("status phase health remains read-only") };
